entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE containing authentication response RES.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by UE indicating authentication failure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate authentication procedure.

entities.name: RES correctness check
entities.description: Network checks if RES received from UE matches expected value.

entities.name: Authentication procedure completed successfully
entities.description: Condition when authentication procedure completes successfully and eKSI is stored in EPS security context.

entities.name: eKSI update requirement
entities.description: Network shall include different eKSI value in new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST when initiating new authentication procedure.

entities.name: EMM cause #21 synch failure
entities.description: Authentication failure condition indicating synchronization failure.

entities.name: HSS/AuC renegotiation
entities.description: Network may renegotiate with HSS/AuC and provide UE with new authentication parameters.

relations.description: Network stops timer T3460 upon receipt of AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
Network performs RES correctness check upon receipt of AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
Successful authentication completion establishes requirement to use different eKSI in next AUTHENTICATION REQUEST.
Network stops timer T3460 upon receipt of AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
Receipt of EMM cause #21 synch failure may trigger HSS/AuC renegotiation.
AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message may contain EMM cause #21 synch failure.
